quarterly_data.signal: Record Q3 across the board: revenue $1.67 billion (top end of guidance, +37% year-on-year, another quarterly record); adjusted gross margin 46.4% (90 basis points above the top of guide, +450 basis points year-on-year, including ~70 basis points of one-time benefit from tariff refunds); adjusted operating expense $400 million (low end of guide); adjusted operating margin a record 22.5% (250 basis points over guide, more than doubling year-on-year); adjusted EPS a record $2.11 (+215% year-on-year, more than triple). Free cash flow $116 million. Mix: total combined optical networks revenue including interconnects grew over 45% year-on-year, with over 55% growth for BOTH RLS and Waveserver systems; interconnects MORE THAN DOUBLED year-on-year; direct cloud provider revenue grew over 80%; the in-and-around-the-data-center percent of revenue has QUADRUPLED year to date, well ahead of the 3x growth committed at the beginning of the year. Two customers each contributed more than 10% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Rev $1.67B +37% YoY; adj GM 46.4%; adj OM record 22.5%; adj EPS $2.11 (+215%); direct cloud rev +80%; FCF $116M

quarterly_data.signal: Backlog surge in an extraordinary demand environment: Q3 book-to-bill significantly greater than one; backlog up $800 million quarter-on-quarter to $8.5 billion, and expected to grow at an even greater rate in Q4 — just one month into Q4, orders booked are approaching a level equal to the ENTIRETY of Q3, and Ciena projects exiting fiscal 2026 with over $10 billion in backlog extending well into fiscal 2028. Orders (demand) doubled from 2024 to 2025 and are expected up another 50% from 2025 to 2026, with backlog doubling in each of those years. The vast majority of the ~$10 billion backlog carries a customer request date in 2027, meaning the backlog covers most of the FY2027 revenue guide. Ciena also recently secured a significant increase in customer commitments that extend through 2029. Customer mix: about 50% of the business is now hyperscalers directly, and 'neo scaler' (neocloud) demand — MOFN deals, own fiber builds — is expected to become an increasingly important part of the business through 2027 and 2028; MOFN growth called explosive in markets like India, plus Japan and parts of the Middle East.
quarterly_data.figure: Backlog +$800M QoQ to $8.5B; >$10B backlog projected exiting FY2026; orders +50% 2025-to-2026 after doubling 2024-to-2025; commitments through 2029

quarterly_data.signal: Guidance raised plus a first look at FY2027: Q4 FY2026 revenue guided to $1.75 billion plus or minus $50 million, raising the full-year midpoint to $6.42 billion (up $120 million from last quarter; ~35% revenue growth this year). Q4 adjusted gross margin 45% plus or minus 50 basis points (full year raised 50 basis points to a similar range); Q4 adjusted opex roughly $415 million plus or minus $10 million (annual opex $1.6 billion); Q4 adjusted operating margin approximately 20% plus or minus 50 basis points, bringing full-year adjusted operating margin to 20-21% — exceeding 20% for the first time in company history. With this guide Ciena expects to increase share of the combined optical systems and plug market by about 4 points to approximately 30%. PRELIMINARY FY2027 outlook: another record year with revenue growing a MINIMUM of 30% year-on-year to at least $8.3 billion to $8.4 billion WITH SUPPLY-DRIVEN UPSIDES (revenue would be higher if supply were greater); gross margin at least 45-46%; adjusted operating margin 25-27%, another record in profitability.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 guide $1.75B +/-$50M; FY2026 midpoint $6.42B; FY2027 initial: minimum 30% growth to at least $8.3-8.4B, GM 45-46%, adj OM 25-27%

quarterly_data.signal: Supply, not demand, is the binding constraint: the industry needs to add significant capacity and management does not see supply and demand getting back into balance BEFORE 2028 — a similarly constrained dynamic is expected going into 2027 and likely into 2028. In recent weeks Ciena FINALIZED LONG-TERM AGREEMENTS that secure supply of certain key components THROUGH 2029, including incremental capacity for those key components; the June five-year zero-coupon convertible (economic conversion premium of 114%, proceeds retiring the 5.5% interest term loan) partly provided the capital to help secure supply over the next three years, and cash from operations will step down in Q4 as those investments are dispersed. Ciena is also qualifying additional suppliers — expanding both the number of suppliers and alternative technologies for the same functionality. Capital investments this year increased capacity sufficient to support RLS, plug and Waveserver revenue growth all over 60% year to date; capex expected at the high end of the $250 million-$275 million range; $2.8 billion in cash and equivalents. Value exchange with customers: price increases from high single digits up to high teens/low 20s depending on customer and product line, some of it selectively hitting backlog, alongside payment-terms and fill-rate discussions; possible new Canadian tariff impact of ~$10 million a quarter being mitigated.
quarterly_data.figure: Key-component supply secured through 2029; supply/demand balance not before 2028; price increases high single digits to high teens/low 20s; capex high end of $250M-$275M

quarterly_data.signal: AI portfolio catalysts: WaveLogic 6 Extreme — after 18 months still the ONLY 1.6 Tb high-performance modem on the market — with a ramp already exceeding WaveLogic 5 Extreme and output doubled. RLS holds roughly 70% market share in disaggregated optical line systems; next-generation RLS HYPER-RAIL (co-created with the hyperscalers for scale-across / distributed AI training over greater distances) is on track for initial customer standardization by the end of calendar 2026 and will ramp to SEVERAL HUNDRED MILLION DOLLARS of revenue in 2027 (could be faster with more components), with economics a step function above RLS and accretive to corporate average margins. Interconnects: Q3 800 ZR pluggable shipments MORE THAN TWICE the previous quarter's volume; strong market receptivity to Nitro, the linear redriver for active copper cable solutions; VESTA, the open co-packaged optics (CPX) solution, received SAMPLE ORDERS FROM SEVERAL ANCHOR CUSTOMERS in the ecosystem — CPX revenue expected to begin in 2027 and ramp into 2028. Coherent moving inside the data center is viewed as inevitable with the right general-market intercept at 3.2 Tb; OCS is welcomed as driving coherent adoption inside the data center faster (no comment on Ciena entering the OCS market itself). The major-hyperscaler WaveLogic 6 Extreme win announced last quarter — DSP, drivers, TIAs and coherent expertise in a complete module deployed across the customer's own global optical platform, a significant takeaway from a component competitor — is one of two bespoke performance-optics consumption-model relationships. TAM expected to effectively double from approximately $25 billion today to approximately $50 billion by 2029; scale-across is a major demand driver, almost entirely North American/US-based and just beginning, with asynchronous training and inference traffic still ahead.
quarterly_data.figure: Hyper-Rail standardization by end-2026, several hundred million dollars of revenue in 2027; 800 ZR plug shipments more than twice QoQ; Vesta CPX sample orders, revenue from 2027; TAM ~$25B to ~$50B by 2029
